description: Permissively licensed open-source projects this repository consumes, vendors or links. Entries are checked by scripts/check_oss_licenses.py.

repositories.name: monaco-editor
repositories.notes: Editor source snapshot and third-party notices are preserved in third_party/monaco-editor.

repositories.name: vscode
repositories.notes: Pinned Code-OSS workbench source, built by the operator; not redistributed from this repository.

repositories.name: llama.cpp
repositories.notes: Local inference executable supplied by the operator; never bundled or downloaded automatically.

repositories.name: agenticSeek
repositories.isolation: Optional separately running service reached over an authenticated HTTP bridge. GPL source is not linked, bundled, imported or redistributed by this repository.
repositories.notes: Requires independent review before any combined distribution.

repositories.name: fastapi
repositories.notes: Installed from PyPI; license metadata ships with the package.

repositories.name: agent-framework
repositories.notes: Architecture reference for agent orchestration; no source copied.

repositories.name: tree-sitter
repositories.notes: Candidate parser backend for future symbol indexing; not yet integrated.

repositories.name: tokenizers
repositories.notes: Reference for tokenisation design; the shipped embedding model is original pure-Python code.

repositories.name: sentence-transformers
repositories.notes: Optional future embedding backend if the operator installs it; not imported at runtime.

repositories.name: faiss
repositories.notes: Reference for approximate nearest-neighbour indexing; not required for the bounded local index.

repositories.name: tiktoken
repositories.notes: Reference for token budgeting; runtime budgeting uses character bounds instead.

repositories.name: pyotp
repositories.notes: Reference for RFC 6238 TOTP semantics; the shipped implementation is original stdlib hmac/base64 code with no runtime dependency.

repositories.name: gitleaks
repositories.notes: Reference for credential-detection patterns; services/api/content_safety.py is an original conservative pattern plus entropy implementation.

repositories.name: react
repositories.notes: Runtime UI library for the dashboard; installed from npm with its license metadata.

repositories.name: vite
repositories.notes: Build tool for the dashboard; its output is plain static assets.

repositories.name: typescript
repositories.notes: Type checker only; no TypeScript source is redistributed.

repositories.name: vite-plugin-react
repositories.notes: React transform for Vite during dashboard builds.
